mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_name AS "教研室", u.user_name AS "教师", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN h_apply.id IS NOT NULL THEN h_score.change_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "横向课题科研项目", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v_apply_top.id IS NOT NULL AND v_apply_top.top_type NOT IN (6, 7) THEN v_score_top.change_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "纵向课题科研项目-校级以上", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v_apply_school.id IS NOT NULL AND v_apply_school.top_type IN (6, 7) THEN v_score_school.change_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "纵向课题科研项目-校级", COALESCE(report.report_score, 0) AS "讲座报告积分", COALESCE(rewards.reward_score, 0) AS "奖励积分", COALESCE(patent.patent_score, 0) AS "专利积分", COALESCE(software.software_score, 0) AS "软著积分", COALESCE(conversion.conversion_score, 0) AS "成果转化积分", COALESCE(SUM(jr.jifen), 0) AS "教材软著积分", COALESCE(paper_score.total_research_score, 0) AS "论文积分" FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id -- 横向课题科研项目连接 LEFT JOIN sci_user_score_history h_score JOIN sci_horizontal_apply h_apply ON h_score.apply_id = h_apply.id ON u.user_id = h_apply.user_id -- 纵向课题科研项目-校级以上连接 LEFT JOIN sci_user_score_vertical v_score_top JOIN sci_horizontal_apply_vertical v_apply_top ON v_score_top.vertical_id = v_apply_top.id AND v_apply_top.top_type NOT IN (6, 7) ON u.user_id = v_apply_top.user_id -- 纵向课题科研项目-校级连接 LEFT JOIN sci_user_score_vertical v_score_school JOIN sci_horizontal_apply_vertical v_apply_school ON v_score_school.vertical_id = v_apply_school.id AND v_apply_school.top_type IN (6, 7) ON u.user_id = v_apply_school.user_id -- 讲座报告积分子查询连接 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.user_id, SUM(s.report_keyanfen) AS report_score FROM sci_lecture_report s GROUP BY s.user_id ) report ON u.user_id = report.user_id -- 奖励积分子查询连接 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.user_id, SUM(r.jifen) AS reward_score FROM sys_reward r WHERE r.state = 6 GROUP BY r.user_id ) rewards ON u.user_id = rewards.user_id -- 专利积分子查询连接 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT su.user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN sz.fenlei IN (1, 2, 3) THEN sz.jifen ELSE 0 END) AS patent_score FROM ( SELECT sz1.* FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu sz1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT mingcheng, MIN(paiming) AS min_paiming FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY mingcheng ) sz2 ON sz1.mingcheng = sz2.mingcheng AND sz1.paiming = sz2.min_paiming ) sz INNER JOIN sys_user su ON sz.user_id = su.user_id GROUP BY su.user_id ) patent ON u.user_id = patent.user_id -- 软著积分子查询连接 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT su.user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN sz.fenlei = 4 THEN sz.jifen ELSE 0 END) AS software_score FROM ( SELECT sz1.* FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu sz1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT mingcheng, MIN(paiming) AS min_paiming FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY mingcheng ) sz2 ON sz1.mingcheng = sz2.mingcheng AND sz1.paiming = sz2.min_paiming ) sz INNER JOIN sys_user su ON sz.user_id = su.user_id GROUP BY su.user_id ) software ON u.user_id = software.user_id -- 成果转化积分子查询连接 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u1.user_id, SUM(sub.allsc) AS conversion_score FROM ( SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name username, sc.earnedALL_Points allsc, d.dept_name dname, d2.dept_name pardname FROM sci_IntraSchPro_score sc LEFT JOIN sci_IntraSchPro_apply ap ON ap.id = sc.sciIntraSch_Id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ap.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d2 ON d2.dept_id = d.parent_id WHERE 1 ) sub INNER JOIN sys_user u1 ON sub.user_id = u1.user_id GROUP BY u1.user_id ) conversion ON u.user_id = conversion.user_id -- 教材软著连接 LEFT JOIN sci_jiaocairuanzhu jr ON u.user_id = jr.user_id -- 论文积分子查询连接 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.user_id, SUM(p.research_score) AS total_research_score FROM sci_paper_a p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.state = 8 GROUP BY u.user_id ) paper_score ON u.user_id = paper_score.user_id WHERE d.dept_id = #{deptId} GROUP BY d.dept_name, u.user_name, report.report_score, rewards.reward_score, patent.patent_score, software.software_score, conversion.conversion_score, jr.jifen, paper_score.total_research_score;
